sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A for the State respondents.
2. By means of present writ petition, the petitioner is seeking direction to the respondent authorities to ensure fair, impartial and proper investigation of Case Crime No. 118 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Bareilly.

3. Learned A.G.A. states on instructions that after investigation, the Investigating Officer has forwarded the charge-sheet No. 97 of 2022 to the competent court on 10.11.2022 and as such, the cause of filing the writ petition no more survives.

entities.text: Idreeshan vs State Of Up And 12 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the categorical statement of learned A.G.A., we are not inclined to proceed further in the matter.
Needless to say that in case the petitioner is aggrieved with the submission of charge sheet, it is always open to him to agitate before the appropriate forum.
5. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
